entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes. It's VF886-1215. The VeloBand tracker.

Got it, VF886-1215. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order, delivered 18 days ago. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just not for me. And I already tried to return it last week, but your website had an error.
I'm very sorry to hear you had trouble with our site. Can you tell me more about that?
The whole return system was down. I got to the last step and I couldn't print the label. It just timed out. I have a screenshot of the error page, if that helps.
Thank you for that information, and I do apologize for the frustration that must have caused. Let me just check the return eligibility for you right now... One moment.
Fine.
Okay, thank you for waiting. It looks like you're actually well within the return window. Our policy for the VeloBand is 90 days, so we can absolutely get this processed for you. No problem at all.
Oh. So I wasted my time fighting with your broken website for nothing. Great.

I understand. Again, I sincerely apologize for that website error. Since you are a VIP member with us, and because of the trouble you went through, I'd like to offer you a $50 credit on your account for your next VeloFit purchase.
Whatever. Just send the return label.

Of course. I've applied the $50 credit to your account, and I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
